title: Explicit three-factor comparison from compatible adjunctions
statement: Take two commutative pullback-square isomorphisms theta:G V to U H and theta_e:G_e V_e to U_e H_e in two four-category diagrams, four vertical comparison functors T_i, adjunctions U adjoint R, V adjoint S and their e analogues. Give invertible comparisons for the four pullbacks and the two right adjoints. Assume the mate unit and counit equations and the displayed pullback cube. Then for every K in the second source category there are four vertex isomorphisms making each of the unit insertion, square transport and counit contraction squares commute. No invertibility of either assembled exchange arrow is assumed.

source.place: unit_mateEquiv and mateEquiv_counit; explicit naturality calculation

proof.text: At the first vertex compose the horizontal pullback comparison with the first right-adjoint comparison. At the middle vertices insert the second right-adjoint comparison, the vertical pullback comparisons, and the images of the first comparison; at the last vertex use the other horizontal comparison.

Naturality and the unit mate equation give the first square. The coherent pullback cube, right-adjoint naturality, and theta_e naturality give the second. The counit mate equation, inverse cancellation and the last pullback comparison naturality give the third.

theorem threeStepComparison
    (θ : G ⋙ V ≅ U ⋙ H) (θe : Ge ⋙ Ve ≅ Ue ⋙ He)
    (αU : U ⋙ T₂ ≅ T₁ ⋙ Ue) (αV : V ⋙ T₄ ≅ T₃ ⋙ Ve)
    (αG : G ⋙ T₃ ≅ T₁ ⋙ Ge) (αH : H ⋙ T₄ ≅ T₂ ⋙ He)
    (δ : R ⋙ T₁ ≅ T₂ ⋙ Re) (δ' : S ⋙ T₃ ≅ T₄ ⋙ Se)
    (hunit : ∀ K, T₃.map (b.unit.app K) ≫ δ'.hom.app (V.obj K) ≫
      Se.map (αV.hom.app K) = be.unit.app (T₃.obj K))
    (hcounit : ∀ K, Ue.map (δ.hom.app K) ≫ ae.counit.app (T₂.obj K) =
      αU.inv.app (R.obj K) ≫ T₂.map (a.counit.app K))
    (hcube : ∀ K, T₄.map (θ.hom.app K) ≫ αH.hom.app (U.obj K) ≫
        He.map (αU.hom.app K) =
      αV.hom.app (G.obj K) ≫ Ve.map (αG.hom.app K) ≫ θe.hom.app (T₁.obj K))
    (K : C₂) :
    Nonempty (FiniteDiscreteThreeStepComparison
      (T₃.map (b.unit.app (G.obj (R.obj K))))
      (T₃.map (S.map (θ.hom.app (R.obj K))))
      (T₃.map (S.map (H.map (a.counit.app K))))
      (be.unit.app (Ge.obj (Re.obj (T₂.obj K))))
      (Se.map (θe.hom.app (Re.obj (T₂.obj K))))
      (Se.map (He.map (ae.counit.app (T₂.obj K)))))
